on_screen_text.text: not Trump crashing out abt Time using this chopped pic of him 😭

Time Magazine wrote a relatively good story about me, but the picture may be the Worst of All Time. They “disappeared” my hair, and then had something floating on top of my head that looked like a floating crown, but an extremely small one. Really weird! I never liked taking pictures from underneath angles, but this is a super bad picture, and deserves to be called out. What are they doing, and why?

spoken_summary: A female voice says, "Wait a minute, why is there a picture of me on Instagram? I didn't tell y'all to put that out... I mean on Twitter that I'm looking at right now. I told y'all to text it to me." The audio clip is used comedically to represent Donald Trump's reaction to the photo.
audio_music: The first six seconds feature a spoken word audio clip of a woman reacting with annoyance. At the 6-second mark, an upbeat, electronic music track ('You Better' by M3D) begins and plays for the remainder of the video.
editing_pacing: A slow-paced slideshow of three static images, each displayed for several seconds.
cultural_references: The audio is a well-known clip of musician Nicki Minaj.
The post is a screenshot from Truth Social, identifiable by the 'ReTruths' label.
central_claim: The post mocks Donald Trump for his publicly expressed vanity and anger over an unflattering Time Magazine cover photo.
intended_effect: To make the viewer laugh at Donald Trump and perceive him as petty and overly concerned with his appearance.
